end.parentNote: Saanvi practised making numbers 11–20 with one bundle of ten and some loose ones. They stated 12 after identifying ten and two loose sticks, but later counted a bundle as 1 in totals such as 1 and 6 making 7; this was not corrected by the last seen attempt. At home, make one group of ten objects and add loose objects, then count all the objects together.
